notes.notes: Fix slow movement speed when playing with a controller.

notes.title: New demo now available!
notes.notes:
🎮 The new demo is now available!
You can now play through the beginning of the game and get a feel for what's in store.
Be sure to check it out and see if it’s something you'd like to add to your library!

-Fixed an issue where physical objects could appear beyond walls
-Adjusted the volume of certain cutscenes
-Fixed an issue where multiple events would trigger simultaneously when starting from specific points
-Fixed an issue where some checkpoints were not functioning correctly
-Fixed an issue where enemies would have abnormal health at high FPS
-Fixed an issue where the camera could see through walls when too close
Support for Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese.
